description: Crawl a website from a starting URL with Tavily, extracting content from the pages it visits.

extract_depth.description: Extraction depth to use during the crawl: "basic" or "advanced".

instructions.description: Natural-language guidance for which pages to visit during the crawl.

limit.description: Maximum total number of pages to crawl.

max_breadth.description: Maximum number of links to follow per page or level during the crawl.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth of links to follow from the starting URL.

url.description: The starting URL to crawl from.

name: tavily-crawl
